title: An OpenAI Model Solved the Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem
raw_excerpt: OpenAI announced that an internal AI system produced a proof resolving the roughly 90-year-old Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, one of mathematics' seven Millennium Prize Problems. The model showed that smooth three-dimensional fluid dynamics can develop a finite-time singularity and produced both an analytical proof and a Lean formalization.
summary: OpenAI 宣布其内部 AI 系统产出了一份证明，解决了困扰数学界约 90 年的 Navier-Stokes 方程存在性与光滑性问题——这是七大千禧年大奖难题之一。模型证明三维流体动力学可在有限时间内形成奇点，并同时给出解析证明与 Lean 形式化验证。这是 AI 首次攻克千禧年难题级别的问题，标志着 AI 在数学发现上的能力跃升，但随后也引发了对学术credit归属的争议。

title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
raw_excerpt: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，定位为面向企业工作场景的最强模型，主打高级推理、计算机操作（computer use）以及更强的写作与设计判断力。结合此前披露的企业收入反超 C 端、6-7 月年化营收增长 20% 等信息，Astra 是 OpenAI 从消费级聊天机器人转向企业生产力市场的关键落子，也直接对 Anthropic Claude Cowork 等竞品形成压力。

title: Introducing Muse: The World's First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
raw_excerpt: Meta introduces Muse, a personal AI agent, powered by Muse Spark, to help users achieve goals by automating tasks like booking travel or sending emails. Muse operates securely on Muse Secure VM, ensuring data privacy with unique protections like the Sentinel agent overseeing actions. Muse will soon offer encrypted data with Muse Confidential VM and is available on iOS, Android, and muse.ai in the US.
summary: Meta 推出个人 AI 智能体 Muse，由 Muse Spark 驱动，可自动完成订机票、发邮件等任务。Muse 运行在 Muse Secure VM 上，并设有 Sentinel 智能体监督其行为以保障数据隐私，后续还将提供加密的 Muse Confidential VM。产品已在美国上线 iOS、Android 与 muse.ai。值得注意的是，Muse 还抢注了英国乐队 Muse 的社交媒体账号，引发命名争议。

title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
raw_excerpt: Suno's new v6 AI music model is its first made with support from the record industry. Suno's Jack Brody told The Verge that v6 was "trained from the ground up, with a new set of data that does not include the same data that our previous models were trained on." The data includes content licensed from partners Warner Music Group , BMG , and Believe , as well as " user data ." It's unclear whether that means v6 training data is completely free of dubiously obtained content . One of the big changes in v6 is that there are actually three different models: v6, v6-wild, and v6-mini. Mini is the model available for free to all. It's focused on fast, res … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Suno 发布 v6 音乐生成模型，这是其首个在唱片工业支持下训练的版本。据 Suno 的 Jack Brody 介绍，v6 从零开始训练，使用全新数据集，包含来自华纳音乐、BMG、Believe 的授权内容及用户数据。v6 分为 v6、v6-wild、v6-mini 三个版本。此举意味着 AI 音乐生成正从版权灰色地带走向与唱片公司合作的正规化路径，对行业版权格局有示范意义。

title: Google's AlphaGenome Maps 9 Billion Genetic Variants
raw_excerpt: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a 1-petabyte database predicting the regulatory effects of all 9 billion possible single-nucleotide variants in the human genome.
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome Atlas，一个容量达 1PB 的数据库，可预测人类基因组中全部 90 亿个单核苷酸变异的调控效应。这是迄今规模最大的基因组变异效应图谱，将大幅降低遗传学研究的实验成本，为疾病相关非编码变异的解读提供基础工具，是 AI 在生命科学领域的重要基础设施级成果。

title: >10x More Efficient Pretraining
raw_excerpt: Without large amounts of compute, small labs can only compete through algorithmic efficiency. Magic's pretraining recipe is now more than 10 times more compute-efficient than that of leading open-weight base models. The startup believes that pretraining, agentic RL, and long-context are sufficient for building superhuman coding agents and automating AI research and development. This post discusses its pretraining and long-context work.
summary: AI 初创公司 Magic 公布其预训练配方，称计算效率已比领先的开源权重基座模型高出 10 倍以上。该公司认为预训练、智能体强化学习与长上下文三者结合，足以构建超人级编程智能体并自动化 AI 研发。这一结果对小算力实验室具有参考价值：在算力受限时，算法效率是唯一可竞争的维度，也再次印证了数据与训练配方的重要性。

title: Introducing Mercury 2.5
raw_excerpt: Mercury 2.5 is the largest diffusion language model ever trained. It performs comparably to cost-optimized frontier models like GPT-5.6 Luna (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, and Claude Haiku 4.5. The model outputs 1,107 tokens per second on widely available Nvidia GPUs and has a 260K-token context window. At launch, Mercury 2.5 is 80% off at $0.04 per million input and $0.15 per million output.
summary: Inception Labs 发布 Mercury 2.5，号称迄今训练过的最大扩散语言模型。其性能与 GPT-5.6 Luna（Low）、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、Claude Haiku 4.5 等成本优化型前沿模型相当，在常见 Nvidia GPU 上输出速度达 1107 tokens/秒，上下文窗口 260K。发布期定价为每百万输入 token 0.04 美元、输出 0.15 美元，相当于八折优惠，对高吞吐低成本场景颇具吸引力。

title: Inside the megakernel serving engine for North Mini Code
raw_excerpt: This post presents a fully fledged serving system built around a decode megakernel. The system supports everything a real server needs: continuous batching, paged attention, and ragged sequence lengths, all behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with tool calling. The megakernel reaches 292 tokens per second on batch size 1, or 62% of SoL - 1.58× faster than vLLM. That margin holds across batch sizes and out to 256K of context with no measurable loss of accuracy.
summary: Cohere 公布其为 North Mini Code 打造的 megakernel 推理服务引擎，完整支持连续批处理、分页注意力与不规则序列长度，并提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口与工具调用。该 megakernel 在 batch size 1 时达到 292 tokens/秒，为理论峰值的 62%，比 vLLM 快 1.58 倍，且该优势在各类 batch size 及 256K 上下文下均保持，精度无明显损失。

title: Pretraining progress is mostly coming from data
raw_excerpt: Between 2019 and 2025, 3.24x more compute efficiency gains have come from data improvements rather than model improvements. The gains from data and model improvements are mostly independent and don't interact. Most model research has consisted of removing or pushing back constraints to scaling. The data improvements may matter less for larger models. Small models see significant gains from data quality.
summary: Dwarkesh Patel 撰文分析预训练进展来源，指出 2019 至 2025 年间，来自数据改进的计算效率提升是模型改进的 3.24 倍，且两者收益基本独立、互不交互。文章认为多数模型研究实质是在移除或推迟扩展约束，而数据改进对大模型的作用可能较小，小模型则能从数据质量中获得显著收益。该结论对预训练资源分配有直接指导意义。

title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
raw_excerpt: Cognition has raised $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation in a funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, and Avenir. The startup's soaring valuation signals that VCs still see room for multiple major players to capture meaningful market share in AI coding. Cognition leases an Nvidia server cluster that could push its total cash burn to $800 million this year. The startup is expected to reach $4 billion to $5 billion in annualized revenue by the end of 2026.
summary: AI 编程公司 Cognition 以 480 亿美元估值完成 20 亿美元融资，由 a16z、Accel、Founders Fund、General Catalyst 与 Avenir 领投。公司今年现金消耗可能达 8 亿美元，预计 2026 年底年化收入达 40 至 50 亿美元。此轮融资表明投资人认为 AI 编程远非赢家通吃市场，仍容得下多个主要玩家，对整个 AI 编程赛道的估值逻辑具有风向标意义。
